subline: Personal injury attorney · Riverton, WV · locations/0000000000000000001
pulse: Calls from the Riverton profile rose to 329, up 6.8% on the prior 13 weeks, while website clicks and direction requests eased. Total actions held at 714 (down 2%). Maps views nearly doubled, but one day in August carries most of that jump, so we are treating the underlying growth as about a third and checking what happened on Aug 17.

callout.k: Profile lists services the firm refers out
callout.body: The description and service list advertise medical malpractice, and the profile surfaced for that search in July. Lemon law and legal malpractice are listed too. Until the list matches what the firm takes, some calls are the wrong calls.

left_chart.title: Weekly calls · last 13 weeks
left_chart.caption: Full weeks ran 15 to 41 calls; the busiest began July 20. *First and last buckets are partial weeks (4 and 3 days) at the window edges.

right_chart.title: Actions by type · last 13 weeks
right_chart.caption: 714 total actions vs 729 in the prior 13 weeks.

flags.text: Calls up 6.8% with the same number of Maps views on a normal day, so more of the people who found the profile called.
Aug 17 carried 183 desktop Maps views against a normal day of 0 to 14. Without that day Maps views were up 32%. We are checking the cause before counting it as growth.
35 new five-star reviews, same as last period, and every one has a reply.
Four one-star reviews from April have no reply and no text. A short reply is still worth posting.
Last photo Oct 2025, last post Jun 30. Fresh photos and a monthly post keep the profile active in Google's eyes.

todo.text: Confirm the service list. Tell us which of medical malpractice, lemon law and legal malpractice the firm takes, and we will remove the rest from the profile.
Check the Aug 17 Maps spike against the Fairview profile and GA4, and report back next run.
